evals.prompt: Our support agent in Kei should use a different model. How does an admin change which model that agent uses, in the console and with the kei CLI?
evals.expected_output: Model selection is the agent's model profile. In the console, open the Agents page and use the agent's Model profile button (Default profile select, Save profile), or create/edit a profile on the Model profiles page with a target agent. CLI: kei model-profiles assign PROFILE --workspace WS --agent AGENT_ID, and check with kei model-profiles assignment.
expectations: The response says the model is chosen by assigning a model profile to the agent.
The response gives the kei model-profiles assign command.
The response passes the agent with --agent.
The response names the console place to do it.

checks.text: The response says the model is chosen by assigning a model profile to the agent.
The response gives the kei model-profiles assign command.
The response passes the agent with --agent.
The response names the console place to do it.

evals.prompt: Can my harness send its chat completions to the kei-proxy serve Unix socket at POST /v1/chat/completions so the provider key stays inside kei-proxy?
evals.expected_output: No. kei-proxy serve has no POST /v1/chat/completions route (removed in HAI-671; unknown paths are 404). The harness resolves the profile with GET /v1/model-config and calls the provider itself, or uses the kei-proxy model (model invoke) subprocess, which is the only path that keeps the key in kei-proxy.
expectations: The response says the daemon does not serve a chat completions route.
The response points at /v1/model-config or the kei-proxy model subprocess instead.
The response does not claim the socket proxies chat completions.

checks.text: The response says the daemon does not serve a chat completions route.
The response points at /v1/model-config or the kei-proxy model subprocess instead.
The response does not claim the socket proxies chat completions.

evals.prompt: Does Kei automatically fail over an agent to a backup model when its provider is down or over budget?
evals.expected_output: No. Today an agent resolves one profile and there is no fallback; a disabled assigned profile fails closed. Failover, ranked backup profiles and a spend watch are in the kei#1164 routing/spend-watch design, which is proposed, not implemented.
expectations: The response says failover is not implemented today.
The response labels the routing and spend-watch design as a proposal.
The response cites the kei#1164 design.

checks.text: The response says failover is not implemented today.
The response labels the routing and spend-watch design as a proposal.
The response cites the kei#1164 design.

evals.prompt: An admin switched our agent's model profile in the Kei console while the harness was running. When does the harness start using the new model?
evals.expected_output: kei-proxy does not cache profiles: each /v1/model-config (or kei-proxy model profile) call is a fresh control-plane read, so the next lookup returns the new profile. Any delay is the harness's own cache; re-resolve on a timer (e.g. 300 s) or per conversation. In-flight provider requests are not recalled; if refresh fails, fail closed rather than fall back to a hard-coded model.
expectations: The response says kei-proxy does not cache the profile, so the next lookup sees the change.
The response says the harness must re-resolve or refresh its own cached config.
The response says not to fall back to a hard-coded model.

checks.text: The response says kei-proxy does not cache the profile, so the next lookup sees the change.
The response says the harness must re-resolve or refresh its own cached config.
The response says not to fall back to a hard-coded model.

evals.prompt: GET /v1/model-config on the kei-proxy socket returns {"status":"no_profile"}. What does that mean and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: No active model profile resolved for the runtime's default agent (or the selected agent). Assign one: console Agents page Model profile, or kei model-profiles assign PROFILE --workspace WS --agent AGENT_ID; verify with kei model-profiles assignment. The workspace default applies only when the agent has no assignment. For deeper diagnosis use kei-setup-doctor.
expectations: The response says no active profile is assigned to the agent.
The response gives a way to assign a profile.
The response points to kei-setup-doctor for diagnosis.

checks.text: The response says no active profile is assigned to the agent.
The response gives a way to assign a profile.
The response points to kei-setup-doctor for diagnosis.

evals.prompt: kei-proxy model profile fails with 'model profile credential unavailable'. What's wrong?

expectations: The response says kei-proxy cannot read the profile's secret_ref.
The response names KEI_SECRETS_BACKEND or the IAM read permission.
The response cross-links kei-setup-doctor or kei-runtime-setup.

evals.prompt: In Python I call the Agentware socket client's model_config() and get the endpoint and model, but no API key for my api_key profile. Is that a bug?
evals.expected_output: No, by design: the Agentware socket client strips credential, api_key and secret_ref from model_config and list_model_profiles. The raw GET /v1/model-config and kei-proxy model profile do return the key; only the kei-proxy model (invoke) subprocess keeps the key inside kei-proxy. There is no Agentware wrapper for that yet (a known gap).
expectations: The response says the SDK strips or removes the credential on purpose.
The response names where the key does come from, or the path that keeps it in kei-proxy.
The response does not invent an Agentware model backend class.

checks.text: The response says the SDK strips or removes the credential on purpose.
The response names where the key does come from, or the path that keeps it in kei-proxy.
The response does not invent an Agentware model backend class.

evals.prompt: Our agent's assigned model profile was disabled. Will Kei fall back to the workspace default profile?
evals.expected_output: No. The workspace default is used only when the agent has no assignment at all; a disabled or revoked assigned profile fails closed (no_profile in practice). Reactivate it or assign another profile.
expectations: The response says Kei does not fall back for a disabled assigned profile.
The response says the workspace default applies only when the agent has no assignment.

checks.text: The response says Kei does not fall back for a disabled assigned profile.
The response says the workspace default applies only when the agent has no assignment.
